Looking at the prime factors, it seems like each term is the LCM of the first few numbers multiplied by additional primes. For example, term 11 is 840, which is LCM(1-7) = 420, but 840 is 420 * 2. Term 12 is 1260, which is LCM(1-7) * 3. Term 13 is 1680 = LCM(1-7) * 4. Term 14 is 2520 = LCM(1-7) * 6. Term 15 is 5040 = LCM(1-7) * 12. Term 16 is 7560 = LCM(1-7) * 18. Term 17 is 10080 = LCM(1-7) * 24. Term 18 is 15120 = LCM(1-7) * 36. Term 19 is 20160 = LCM(1-7) * 48. Term 20 is 25200 = LCM(1-7) * 60. Term 21 is 27720 = LCM(1-7) * 66. Term 22 is 45360 = LCM(1-7) * 108. Term 23 is 50400 = LCM(1-7) * 120. Term 24 is 55440 = LCM(1-7) * 132. 

But LCM(1-7) is 420. So the sequence seems to be 420 multiplied by 2, 3, 4, 6, 12, 18, 24, 36, 48, 60, 66, 108, 120, 132, etc. This doesn't seem to follow a clear pattern either.
